info.title: Deputy Universal API
info.description: Schedule staff, track time, and manage leave with Deputy

post.description: Creates a new shift in Deputy.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

intStartTimestamp.description: Start time of the shift in unix timestamp format.

intEndTimestamp.description: End time of the shift in unix timestamp format.

intRosterEmployee.description: Id of the employee working the shift when the shift is filled.

blnPublish.description: Whether the shift should be published.

intMealbreakMinute.description: Number of minutes to include as a meal break.

intOpunitId.description: The location or area id for the shift.

blnForceOverwrite.description: Whether to force overwrite with 0 or 1.

blnOpen.description: Whether the shift is open using 0 or 1.

intConfirmStatus.description: Whether the employee's shift should be confirmed with 1 or 0.

post.description: Creates a new leave request in Deputy.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

Employee.description: The id record number of the employee who is requesting leave.

LeaveRule.description: The id record number of the Leave Rule being included.

Company.description: The location which the leave application is being applied against.

DateStart.description: The start date of the leave in YYYY-MM-DD format.

Start.description: The start time of the leave in unix timestamp format.

DateEnd.description: The end date of the leave in YYYY-MM-DD format.

End.description: The end time of the leave in unix timestamp format.

Comment.description: A comment explaining the leave to the manager from the employee.
